title: Shared Tensor-Train adapter cores with Mirror phase views
hypothesis: For a bank of 128 aligned TT adapter functions, storing one phase per task to modulate a selected shared TT core will reduce total serialized bytes by at least 10% versus storing two free coefficients per task at the same core while preserving held-out normalized function MSE <=1e-4. A second mixed bank of 96 aligned and 32 unrelated TT functions will test whether private factors erase this saving.
physical_object: shared order-4 Tensor-Train adapter factors with dimensions 8x8x8x8 and TT ranks 4
mirror_coordinate: one FP16 phase per aligned task; selected middle TT core is G2 + rho*(cos(theta)*U + sin(theta)*V), with shared rho=0.25 and charged U/V core directions
logical_multiplicity: 128 phase-orbit task adapters in aligned bank; 96 orbit tasks plus 32 unrelated adapters with private TT factors in mixed bank
controls: native LoRETTA-style independent per-task TT factors
shared TT factors plus two free scalar coefficients per task on selected core, with same private TT fallback
shared TT factors plus one Mirror phase per aligned task, with same private TT fallback

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes after reload
storage.format: fixed-timestamp ZIP with sorted uncompressed NPY tensors
storage.private_rule: validation nMSE >1e-4 stores that task's independent TT factors in both shared methods

gates.promising: All 3 fresh seeds in both aligned and mixed banks: Mirror package <=0.90x the matched shared-TT/free-pair control, max task test nMSE<=1e-4, and no additional private tasks versus the control.
gates.fail: Mirror package >= the free-pair control in >=2 fresh seeds in either bank, or max task nMSE>1e-4 in >=2 fresh seeds.
gates.not_established: Serialization/hash replay mismatch or split leakage

boundaries: teacher deliberately uses one selected-core phase orbit
no optimizer training, real pretrained language model, learned router, or capacity claim
LoRETTA represented by independent TT factors, not a full method reproduction
